dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do a lot of people purchase on credit?

dialogues.speaker: Grigory
dialogues.text: ...In the past? Occasionally, but numbers are up nowadays.

dialogues.speaker: Grigory
dialogues.text: Everyone's got their fair share of problems, and our clientele here at Bryatska are often nearby residents. And around these parts, there's always a cold chill of misfortune waiting around the corner to ruin someone's life...

dialogues.speaker: Grigory
dialogues.text: So though we call it selling on credit, it's more like doing someone a favor.
